app_tagline: Tiered Irrigation & Disease Radar for Marginal Farmers
greeting: Namaste {name}. Here is your KisanSathi advisory for today.
signal_red: Red signal. Irrigate today. Refill deficit with about {hours} hours of pumping ({liters} liters).
signal_yellow: Yellow signal. Irrigate in 1 to 2 days. Estimated pumping time will be about {hours} hours.
signal_green: Green signal. Soil moisture is sufficient. Wait and check again on {next_date}.
alert_inspect: Alert: {disease} reported in nearby village {village}. Inspect your {crop} field today.
weekly_saving: This week you saved {hours} hours of pumping, conserving {liters} liters of groundwater and saving ₹{rupees}.
disease_unsure: Unsure - image sent to extension officer for expert verification. Do not apply chemicals yet.

disease_advice.Tomato___Early_blight: Tomato Early Blight detected ({conf}%). Remove lower infected leaves and avoid overhead sprinkler watering. Inspect field.
disease_advice.Tomato___Late_blight: Tomato Late Blight detected ({conf}%). High moisture risk. Avoid flood irrigation, stake plants for airflow, inspect leaves daily.
disease_advice.Wheat___Brown_rust: Wheat Brown Rust detected ({conf}%). Inspect leaf undersides for orange pustules. Avoid nitrogen over-application.
disease_advice.Maize___Northern_Leaf_Blight: Maize Northern Leaf Blight detected ({conf}%). Inspect spindle leaves for oblong lesions. Ensure good field drainage.
disease_advice.Cotton___Bacterial_blight: Cotton Bacterial Blight (Angular Leaf Spot) detected ({conf}%). Inspect lower canopy and remove fallen infected debris.
disease_advice.Healthy: Plant leaf appears healthy and vigorous ({conf}%). Continue routine field monitoring.
